summary: Phase A (Iter7) — Theme preference + Profile views Premium gating + Platform counter (admin override) + extended application statuses. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: all 18 verification points passed (Landing/Settings/Dashboard candidate/Dashboard company/Admin). Dark mode toggle works for both anon (theme-toggle-anon) and logged users (theme-toggle); theme persists after reload via /me/theme. Profile-views block visible on candidate AND company dashboards; Premium grant via admin endpoint unlocks viewer list (1 viewer-row rendered for lucas.martin after granting). Admin admin-platform-stats block fully functional (show-counter, use-manual, displayed-count, public-message, save-platform-stats → 'Compteur public mis à jour' toast). Platform counter renders both on landing and dashboards; correctly hidden when show_counter=false. Extended statuses internship_obtained/apprenticeship_obtained/contract_signed all accepted by PATCH /applications/{id}/status and counted by real_obtained_count.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 402 for non-premium users (intentional per spec choice b). Note: 402 is non-standard for this UX; consider 403 with payload {requires_premium:true} for better client semantics. Currently the frontend correctly handles 402 via PremiumLock CTA so no functional break.

Writes is_premium / premium_end_date to user.profile (nested) while several other endpoints read from root user.is_premium. _is_premium() correctly checks both, but two sources of truth are fragile — recommend centralising premium state at user root.

issues: Top-of-page screenshot shows platform-counter as a small subtle line under greeting — visually low-contrast vs dashboard cards; consider styling it as a colored pill to match landing's 'sparkle + count' badge for consistency.

Theme toggle is a single sun/moon icon that toggles between dark↔light only — does not surface the 'system/auto' option (which is available in /settings). Minor UX inconsistency; intentional likely (3-way picker in settings, 2-way quick toggle in header).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Unify is_premium storage (profile vs root) — currently dual-read via _is_premium() works but is fragile.
OPTIONAL: Reconsider HTTP 402 for premium-gated endpoints (403+payload would be more standard); current code is functional.
MINOR (design): Make dashboard platform-counter visually stronger (badge styling) to match landing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3242 lines — still well past the 700-line threshold flagged in iter5/iter6. Phase A added ~170 lines of theme/profile-views/platform-stats; good opportunity to split into backend/social_proof.py + backend/theme.py.

PATCH /me/theme accepts a raw dict (line 3074) without Pydantic — same pattern flagged before (PUT /api/cv, PUT /api/profile-v2). Validation is inline (`pref in (...)`) which is OK for a 1-field endpoint but inconsistent with the rest of the API.

Profile view logging in GET /users/{id} (line 311–332) is fire-and-forget inside the request — if profile_views collection becomes hot, this adds latency to public profile reads. Consider moving to background task via FastAPI BackgroundTasks.
OBTAINED_STATUSES set is duplicated implicitly between line 1642 (allowed for PATCH) and 3145 (counted by /stats/platform). Extract a single source of truth at module top.
_is_premium reads from both user root and profile dict — defensive but indicates schema drift; admin grant-premium endpoint should be aligned with the canonical location.
/admin/platform-stats PUT serialises public_message with [:200] truncation but no Pydantic — acceptable but inconsistent.
